title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027

quotes.text: November 17, 2026
quotes.for: Date of the third-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings release.

quotes.text: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago.
quotes.for: Third-quarter revenue and sequential and year-over-year growth.

quotes.text: For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 74.8% and 74.9%, respectively. GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.70 and $2.68, respectively.
quotes.for: Third-quarter gross margins and diluted earnings per share.

quotes.text: Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.
quotes.for: Kress statement on Vera Rubin and Nvidia's roadmap.

quotes.text: During the third quarter of fiscal 2027, NVIDIA returned $28.1 billion to shareholders in the form of shares repurchased and cash dividends.
quotes.for: Shareholder returns in the third quarter.

quotes.text: Third-quarter revenue was $107.6 billion, up 21% from the previous quarter and up 110% from a year ago.
quotes.for: Data Center revenue and growth rates.

quotes.text: Ramped production and began shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 — the fastest product ramp in the company’s history — with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius
quotes.for: Vera Rubin NVL72 shipments and cloud partners.

quotes.text: Third-quarter Edge Computing revenue was $8.2 billion, up 14% from the previous quarter and up 42% from a year ago.
quotes.for: Edge Computing third-quarter revenue.

quotes.text: GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be between 71.0% and 72.0%.
quotes.for: Fourth-quarter gross margin guidance.

title: Hours after Huang offers to return, Nvidia chair says no plan to reinstate him as CEO

quotes.text: Published 18 Nov 2026
quotes.for: Publication date of the Mint article.

quotes.text: Jones said Huang had voluntarily resigned "after disclosure of personal behaviour inconsistent with the company's code of conduct standards and cultural norms". The board's November 12 statement announcing the resignation had not given a reason.
quotes.for: Jones's explanation on the call and the contrast with the November 12 statement.

quotes.text: Since his departure, Nvidia's employees, investors, business partners and customers have called for him to return as CEO, and many continue to reach out to him directly, he said.
quotes.for: Huang saying employees, investors, partners and customers called on him to return.

quotes.text: I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at Nvidia, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life. I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret,
quotes.for: Huang's apology in his post on X.

quotes.text: adding that he owns his mistakes completely and is committed to cooperating with the board's independent investigation.
quotes.for: Huang committing to cooperate with the board's investigation.

quotes.text: More than 1.98 lakh people, including over 10,024 who say they are current Nvidia employees, had signed an open letter seeking Huang's reinstatement as of early Wednesday, according to the campaign website standwithjensen.com. Tesla CEO Elon Musk is among the signatories.
quotes.for: Petition signature counts on standwithjensen.com.

quotes.text: Meanwhile, Nvidia's net income more than doubled to USD 65.3 billion for the quarter ended October 25, 2026, from USD 31.9 billion a year earlier.
quotes.for: Third-quarter GAAP net income of $65.3 billion.
